## 2024-11-23 - Command Injection & SSRF from Log Parsing
**Vulnerability:** Extracted variables from untrusted log files (e.g., IPs, PIDs, Place IDs) were being directly passed as arguments to `Process()` shell invocations and concatenated into external URLs without strict validation, creating critical risks for Command Injection and Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).
**Learning:** Application logs generated by user-controlled actions in third-party applications (like Roblox) must be treated as hostile, untrusted input. Maliciously crafted inputs within these logs can bypass standard parsing logic and be executed when processed by background watcher services.
**Prevention:** Always apply strict allow-list regex validation (e.g., `^[a-fA-F0-9.:]+$` for IPs, `^[0-9]+$` for PIDs/IDs) to any data extracted from logs before utilizing it in shell executions or network requests.
